title: Understand Splunk Queues and Processing Bottlenecks
objectives: Understand Splunk Queues and Processing Bottlenecks
Demonstrate actual outcomes and independently inspect evidence.

tasks.instruction: In Monitoring Console home inspect the recorded-input buffer for hf01 /var/log/practice/operations.log: four explicit records are accepted, with a backlog under active limits.conf [thruput] maxKBps=1. This is an opt-in teaching queue, not a full native queue implementation.

Stage maxKBps=0 on hf01, compare disk with running btool evidence, then restart the virtual service to activate it. Advance one tick, verify accepted=delivered=4 and pending=0, then search index=ops_logs | stats count and open Job Inspector. Zero removes the configured throttle; do not discard pending records or reset the checkpoint.

hints: Inspect running source and actual receipts before changing configuration.
Use the paused fixture clock deliberately; verify results through a separate view or query.

references.vendorVersion: Splunk security saved-search notable configuration family
references.purpose: Native action.notable parameters; bounded execution documented

checks.label: Actual backlog accepted and drained without duplicate records
Actual search job and inspector evidence

feedback.success: Verified operational state and retained evidence meet the lesson outcomes.
feedback.incomplete: Inspect actual source, activation, receipts and independent evidence.
